about: Who is usually involved in a kind of work, so a question about 'staff' or 'who sees this' can offer the likely answers instead of a blank box. Detected by rule from the person's words; every offer is confirmed in the read-back.

access.question: What can they see, and when?

options.label: Only what the {person} chooses to share, after they grant it: one way, from the {person} to staff
options.means: staff see only what the person chooses to share, and only after the person grants it; information flows one way, from the person to staff

options.label: A summary the {person} can also see
options.means: staff see a summary that the person can also see

options.label: Everything, as soon as it is entered
options.means: staff see everything the person enters, as soon as it is entered

revoke.question: Can the {person} take that permission back?

options.label: Yes, at any time, and staff stop seeing it at once
options.means: the person can withdraw permission at any time, and staff stop seeing it at once

options.label: Yes, but what staff already saw stays in their records
options.means: the person can withdraw permission for anything new; what staff already saw stays in their records

options.label: No
options.means: once granted, permission cannot be withdrawn
